ticket.summary: Stable dinner-plate-sized damp/yellow ceiling patch in bedroom below neighbor's upstairs bathroom, no dripping, unchanged for 3 days - diagnostic visit booked.
mitigation_advice: Stay clear of the damp area and don't press on it; if the ceiling sags or becomes water-heavy, keep away and call immediately [PB-08]

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit to trace ceiling moisture source (likely from upstairs bathroom - may need neighbor access)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Omar - Tue Sep 1, 10:30 AM, diagnostic visit at $89, and we'll quote any repair before starting. Nice touch giving your neighbor a heads-up; that'll save us time tracing it. If the patch suddenly spreads, starts dripping, or the ceiling bulges before then, stay clear of it and call us right away.
